name: ExactSeek

sources.title: ExactSeek homepage - search engine / web directory
Submit Your Website to ExactSeek - free Add URL form

conditions: Free submission requires the submitted site to have proper Title and Meta Description tags
Submitter must respond to a verification email sent after Membership Signup — no response means the site is not added
Submitting implies consent to receive the free SiteProNews webmaster newsletter
requirements: Site must have proper Title and Meta Description tags or it will not be added
Submitter must agree to the Terms of Service (checkbox on the form)
Email verification after member signup is mandatory
A separate 'Add Local USA Listing' path exists at local.exactseek.com for US local businesses
preparation: Website URL with valid Title and Meta Description already in place
Submitter name and a monitored email address
Readiness to receive the SiteProNews newsletter (bundled consent)
workflow: Go to https://www.exactseek.com/add.html ('Add URL' in the nav)
Enter URL, name, and email; tick the Terms of Service agreement
Watch for the membership/verification email and respond to it — the site is not added otherwise
Optionally, US local businesses can use 'Add Local USA Listing' at local.exactseek.com
watchFor: The form auto-consents you to the SiteProNews newsletter — use an email you control
Missing Title/Meta Description on the target page silently disqualifies the submission
Heavy upsell environment: Featured Website Listing ($14.95/3mo top-10 exposure), Rapid Search Engine Inclusion (24h), Web Traffic Program, Video Boost — none required for the free listing
This is a general web directory/search engine, not a SaaS-specific launch — link value is modest and listing is not instant
Also listed as part of the Jayde Online network; sister services (FreeWebSubmission, SonicRun) are cross-promoted
countsAsLive: The submitted URL appears in ExactSeek search results (site: or keyword query returns the listing)
unknowns: Time from verified submission to appearing in search results
Whether the directory entry links dofollow to the submitted site (catalog note says follow; not confirmed on site)
Whether the member signup requires a full account before the URL is queued
